title: Session row (data/history.json item, data/latest.json)
description: One NSE trading session. Figures in INR crore. F&O fields are 0 until NSE publishes participant OI (later than cash). Invariants: net = buy - sell (±1); date is DD-Mon-YYYY; one row per date; history sorted newest-first. Rows with _source "mirror-groww" were recovered from public mirrors (cross-checked) when NSE blocked the feed; F&O fields fill in later from NSE archives. Rows with _partial=true (_source "archive-net") carry real net figures but null gross legs; they are cross-checked against independent archives.

fii_buy.description: Gross ₹ Cr. null only on _partial (net-only) rows — never a guess.

fii_sell.description: Gross ₹ Cr. null only on _partial (net-only) rows — never a guess.

dii_buy.description: Gross ₹ Cr. null only on _partial (net-only) rows — never a guess.

dii_sell.description: Gross ₹ Cr. null only on _partial (net-only) rows — never a guess.

_cross_checked.description: mirror-groww rows: net figures agreed with Moneycontrol

_partial.description: true = net-only session: gross buy/sell unknown (published only as net by the archives).
